# Run book: Cache a value

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/cache-a-value.md) | [Spec](../specs/cache-a-value.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

Keep expensive results close by behind one interface; switch between in-memory and Redis by configuration, not code.

## Preconditions

- The example stack is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Cache a value"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/data/cache`:

1. **Store a value.** Pick a key, some text and how long it should live, then press Store. Expect: A confirmation names the key.
2. **Look it up.** Look the key up. The result also names the caching provider that answered. Expect: The stored text is shown. The provider name is shown.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Look up says not found right after Store | The lifetime passed or the provider is per request | Raise the seconds, and check which provider the lookup reports |
| Error about no ICachingProvider | No caching provider is registered or selected | Register a provider and set OoBDev:CachingProvider:Type |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Caching (`ICachingProvider`); OoBDev.Microsoft.Caching; OoBDev.Redis.Caching.
